import collections,importlib.util,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd(); G=Path('plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification/reports/phase-09/g9'); T=Path('/tmp/fgos-work/w10-g9-rework')
commands=json.loads((G/'w10-commands.json').read_text())
def save(p,d):p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def run(args,name=None,expect=0):
 r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True)
 commands.append({'argv':args,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout.decode(),'stderr':r.stderr.decode()})
 save(G/'w10-commands.json',commands)
 if name:(G/name).write_bytes(r.stdout)
 print(args,'exit',r.returncode,flush=True)
 if not name:print(r.stdout.decode()[:2000],r.stderr.decode()[:2000],flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==expect
 return r
run(['python3','-B',str(G/'judge.py'),'--pin','HEAD'],'w10-judge-summary.json')
run(['python3','-B',str(G/'verify.py'),'--pin','HEAD'],'w10-verify-summary.json')
run(['python3','-B',str(G/'sweep.py'),'--check'],'sweep-check.json')
old=json.loads((T/'judgments.json').read_text())['rows']; new=json.loads((G/'judgments.json').read_text())['rows']
b={r['id']:r for r in new};changes=[]
for a in old:
 n=b[a['id']]
 if a['classification']!=n['classification'] or a['disposition']!=n['disposition']:
  changes.append({'id':a['id'],'classificationBefore':a['classification'],'classificationAfter':n['classification'],'dispositionBefore':a['disposition'],'dispositionAfter':n['disposition'],'unresolvedDependencies':n.get('unresolvedDependencies',[])})
moved=[c for c in changes if c['classificationBefore']=='changed' and c['classificationAfter']=='moved']
parked=[c for c in changes if c['dispositionBefore']=='still-valid-as-recorded' and c['dispositionAfter']=='owned-park']
assert len(moved)==20 and len(parked)==5 and len(changes)==25
save(G/'w10-judgment-delta.json',{'recordChanges':changes,'duplicateLineRowsReclassified':20,'dependencyRowsParked':5,'classificationCounts':dict(collections.Counter(r['classification'] for r in new)),'dispositionCounts':dict(collections.Counter(r['disposition'] for r in new))})
# Authenticate that the new check catches stale composition even while all
# current source judgments are green. Inject the *real* saved old packet only
# into the read-only verifier's loader; no repository file is temporarily stale.
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('sweep',G/'sweep.py');s=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(s)
current=s.load; stale=json.loads((T/'recomposed.json').read_text())
s.load=lambda p:stale if p==s.HERE/'recomposed.json' else current(p)
negative=s.spec_sweep('HEAD');assert len(negative['predecessorChainMismatches'])==5
rows,_=s.records_at('HEAD');assert not s.judgment_errors(rows)
s.load=current
assert not s.spec_sweep('HEAD')['predecessorChainMismatches']
save(G/'w10-chain-control.json',{'staleRealPacketMismatches':negative['predecessorChainMismatches'],'currentJudgmentErrors':0,'currentPacketMismatches':0,'inMemoryOnly':True,'reason':'The before-recompose --check actually exited 1; this isolated replay confirms the five stale chains independently of the classifier judgment refresh.'})
r=run(['git','show','HEAD:scripts/check-legacy-docs-ratchet.exceptions.json'])
(T/'head-exceptions.json').write_bytes(r.stdout)
pre=run(['node','scripts/check-legacy-docs-ratchet.mjs','--exceptions',str(T/'head-exceptions.json'),'--json'],'w10-ratchet-before.json',1)
after=run(['node','scripts/check-legacy-docs-ratchet.mjs','--json'],'w10-ratchet-after.json',1)
assert json.loads(pre.stdout)==json.loads(after.stdout)
run(['node','scripts/check-legacy-docs-ratchet.mjs'],'w10-ratchet.log',1)
run(['git','diff','--check'])
run(['git','diff','--cached','--name-only'])
print('counts',json.loads((G/'w10-judgment-delta.json').read_text())['dispositionCounts'])
print('ratchet pre-existing failures byte-equal; no digest exception changed')
initialG9Harness:
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path.cwd()
G=Path('plans/260925-documentation-authority-unification/reports/phase-09/g9')
T=Path('/tmp/fgos-work/w10-g9-rework')
commands=[]
def run(args,name=None,expect=0):
 r=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True)
 commands.append({'argv':args,'exit':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout.decode(),'stderr':r.stderr.decode()})
 (ROOT/G/'w10-commands.json').write_text(json.dumps(commands,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 if name: (ROOT/G/name).write_bytes(r.stdout)
 print(args,'exit',r.returncode,flush=True)
 if name and name.endswith('.json'):
  d=json.loads(r.stdout)
  print({k:d[k] for k in ['classificationCounts','uniqueRecords','counts','files','patchInvocations','status'] if k in d},flush=True)
 else: print(r.stdout.decode()[:3000],r.stderr.decode()[:3000],flush=True)
 assert r.returncode==expect
 return r
prefix=['python3','-B']
run(prefix+[str(G/'sweep.py'),'--check'],'w10-before-recompose-check.json',1)
before=json.loads((ROOT/G/'w10-before-recompose-check.json').read_text())
assert len(before['specSweep']['predecessorChainMismatches'])==5
run(prefix+[str(G/'recompose.py'),'--pin','HEAD'],'w10-recompose-summary.json')
old=json.loads((T/'recomposed.json').read_text());new=json.loads((ROOT/G/'recomposed.json').read_text())
a={s['path']:s for s in old['specs']};b={s['path']:s for s in new['specs']}
changes=[p for p in a if any(a[p][k]!=b[p][k] for k in ['diff','rollbackDiff','beforeSha256','expectedAfterSha256'])]
assert sorted(changes)==sorted(x['path'] for x in before['specSweep']['predecessorChainMismatches'])
(ROOT/G/'w10-recomposition-delta.json').write_text(json.dumps({'bodyChanges':changes,'unchangedBodies':len(a)-len(changes),'unresolved':new['unresolved']},indent=2)+'\n')
run(prefix+[str(G/'judge.py'),'--pin','HEAD'],'w10-judge-summary.json')
run(prefix+[str(G/'verify.py'),'--pin','HEAD'],'w10-verify-summary.json')
run(prefix+[str(G/'sweep.py'),'--check'],'sweep-check.json')
run(['node','scripts/check-legacy-docs-ratchet.mjs'],'w10-ratchet.log')
run(['git','diff','--check'])
note: Initial harness intentionally required ratchet exit 0 and stopped on the real failure. Final harness expects/report its unchanged exit 1; it is not a passing assignment claim. Disposition/chain controls are in-memory/read-only; no product fixture or runtime check is bypassed.
